name: pytorch-rocm-halo
description: Daily PyTorch/ROCm base for AMD Strix Halo / RDNA3.5 / gfx1151. Built from ROCm/vLLM thin CI base, installs rocm[devel,libraries] + torch + torchvision from v2-staging/gfx1151, runs rocm-sdk init, and exports /opt/rocm-pytorch-constraints.txt for downstream vLLM builds.
